steps.name: Epilogue ~ Where bondage leaves (1)
steps.objective: Check out the stories with guests who visited [Siam] in “The World Between Times.”

lines.text: (The wizard, who was looking at the sky in the dark, feels an unusual energy. Although he cannot see it, he looks around and moves forward.)
(Siam is slightly surprised when someone holds his hand. He remembers the warmth he feels from the small hand and immediately calls out the name of the person he misses.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello Siam… . long time no see.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Are you really Miss Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .
(Siam loses his cane at Iris's answer. As Iris picks up the cane and hands it to Siam, what he was holding in without realizing it explodes.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris Miss, don’t feel sorry for me or feel sorry for me. This was completely my choice... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Don't cry. If you cry, it will rain on the hearts of everyone who believes in you... . therefore…

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Pop.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Pop. Yes, pop… I will do it.
(Iris wipes away her tears and laughs.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Iris I remembered what Miss said. Your grandmother said that if you do this, the crying will stop.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam. Did you remember?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Don't forget that he is a wizard who has a good memory and can quickly memorize many spells. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But how did we get here? This must have been a space that Iris Yang couldn't reach... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ‘He’ who had been threatening this place for a long time has disappeared. There was help from many people.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I think I understand now... . It was a vice... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Phew, Azrael… . It's a little sad to think that I can't go back, but... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam, although Vice's Azrael has disappeared... , Azrael of Siam is still there.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Could it be that it was like that?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: While living in this place where the flow of time and space is distorted, I learned that there are multiple times in Etoire.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: However, I didn't know that Azrael also had multiple times.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That's why I couldn't understand that the hero I knew had become evil to protect Azrael... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I'm sorry, beings from our world have disturbed this place. Even though I wasn't in his world... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Like Siam said, don't feel sorry for me. Because that's not what Siam did.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Then, if I get the chance in the future, I would like to do what I can for Etoire as a resident of Azrael. Will you allow it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: No, Ms. Iris, I am more grateful. Please come visit often and chat. Uh, Ms. Iris?
(Iris pulls Siam’s hand.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will help Siam feel a new light.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please follow me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Everyone is waiting for Siam to come back.

steps.name: Epilogue ~ Where bondage leaves (2)
steps.objective: Check out the story with the customer who visited [Dragon Adkina] in “The Burning Wheel.”

lines.text: (In an unoccupied cart, a huge dragon with blue scales sits with its eyes closed.)
(When Adkina opens her eyes, she makes eye contact with a being looking at her lovingly.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Have you been there?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Yes, I went there briefly. The vise was shaking a lot of the time so I had to check that place… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: As always, time seems to flow differently there.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Because that's the place it should be.
(Gaia looks silently into Adkina’s eyes.)
(Adkina also quietly stretches her head forward as if she knows what Gaia's eyes mean. Then Gaia quietly caresses Adkina's face.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Adkina, I came to say hello.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. This time, I wanted to stay on this earth for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: No, Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Adkina, I am always grateful to you for guiding and supporting me when I was unable to do anything.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: To Iris, who became the new owner of the star... . To %s who is with Iris… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And to Baldrick, Ziscard, Shinik, Io, and Medea who were with you... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Even though I can't say thank you in person, I want to say it properly the next time we meet.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will tell you. You don't need to worry too much. however… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Iris Do you know? Gaia is heading to ‘Pneuma’.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now that I'm back, you'll also know Iris. However, Iris cannot be found now. Because I'm used to that place, I might be a bad influence... . I have to leave right away... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It was that kind of place.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Weaver in Pneuma… , no, please say hello to that child too.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I will. And Adkina. thank you… .
(Gaia quietly closes her eyes and a small butterfly flies into the wheel.)
(The butterfly soon circles around and slowly takes Gaia somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: We will wait until you come back… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even if you wake up in a different form, I will find out first... .
(The lonely voice of someone looking at a memory of a certain place flows in the dark.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This time you were lucky. Iris I never thought that child would change fate like that.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I said I would take you to meet Ceres, right? I hate you for not letting me keep that promise.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I'll watch for a bit this time. Because there are others who want the world you loved to disappear.
It's a long conversation.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Haha, will you also call me a weakling?
No.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: For a moment, not you, but a creature of a designer who went to another world fell here. So it was unpleasant, but I'm okay now.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you are not a perfect being.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Why did you answer my call? You could probably pass by without knowing.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: I know that you too pursue the ‘salvation’ that sinners long for. So I called to check. Everything is your understanding of creation and will... .
Are you done now?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: That's it. There was something I wanted to check. Then go back right away.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ah, the road to the ‘salvation’ you desire will never be easy.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: There are still many alien beings in that land other than you. Demons and demons, people of the goddess, sinners who escaped their fate... .

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: And waiting for the night... .
That's it.
This is my only time meeting you. And I don't want to see you again until everything is over.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Don’t you think everything is too long, hahaha? Then I'll send you back to where you were.
(As the person who was talking to the old man disappears, the old man slowly moves his gaze somewhere in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: A being that is merely someone's creation doesn't show its cards.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Then a new day to come... , looking forward to a new night.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Oh, I almost forgot.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: The goddess' errand boy who is watching this can now open his eyes.
